critical_code_review_comments: routes/marketplace.py returns Mongo internals: create_gig and patch_gig both call _clean_gig which pops _id -> id. Good. But my_gigs uses `_clean_gig(g)` inside an async list comp — also fine. Confirmed no raw ObjectId leaks (all _id are string uuid4 anyway).

PATCH /api/marketplace/gigs/{id}: patched fields validated only for 'category'. Consider validating booking_mode + whatsapp requirement on PATCH too — currently an owner can PATCH booking_mode='whatsapp' with empty whatsapp and bypass the create-time guard. Low priority for Phase 1a.
POST /api/marketplace/gigs/{id}/book allows a provider to book their own gig (no self-book check). Low priority but worth guarding in Phase 1b.
GET /api/marketplace/gigs (public browse) fetches provider+user per gig in a loop -> N+1 queries. Fine for MVP but consider batching for scale.

wizard-publish flow: gallery step was skipped in test (only optional), and price was entered but not delivery_days. All optional per model — publish worked. If UX requires gallery in Phase 1b, add validation.

MyGigsTab does not appear to expose the delete-with-confirm test (my-gigs-delete-{id} testid present in code but delete flow was not exercised in this run because the just-published gig list was long). Recommend adding an inline confirm modal + testid so E1 can regression-test delete.

success_rate.frontend: 12/12 tests pass; delete-with-confirm not exercised end-to-end
